issues.description: The field 'firstName' in Person is declared private in the template but public in the solution. This is a visibility inconsistency between the template and the reference solution. It is likely unintentional (the rest of the class follows the JavaBean pattern with getters/setters) and may confuse students when they compare template and solution code or when they rely on encapsulation and getters/setters. Although this does not prevent implementing the intended functionality, it is an inconsistent structural detail that should be reconciled.
issues.suggested_fix: Restore consistent visibility for the 'firstName' field across template and solution. Prefer making it private (matching the JavaBean pattern used by the class) and access it via the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName() methods. Concretely, change the solution's declaration from 'public String firstName;' to 'private String firstName;'.
